name: Moto Azumamaro
concept: He rides ahead of messengers who have not finished their sentences, and arrives at the next camp before they do.

answers.giri: Moto Azumamaro serves Moto Shigeaki, who has him ride the borderlands alone watching for the Taint before it spreads into the herds and camps, and who grows impatient with reports that arrive too slowly to act on.
answers.ninjo: Azumamaro wants to ride deeper into the Shadowlands than any Moto has ridden before, to find where the Taint begins, even if it means not returning to report back.
answers.standout_quality: Azumamaro recognized the smell of Taint on a visiting elder before the elder recognized it in himself, and spoke the name of what he had seen in his own clan's borderlands rather than let silence protect the man's pride.
answers.accomplishment: He identified the Taint in Moto Daichi at the summer gathering in 1119 and spoke it aloud before the poison could spread through the clan's breeding lines, though Daichi was Shigeaki's closest advisor and the accusation cost Azumamaro three years of trust he has not recovered.
answers.challenge: Azumamaro rides the borderlands alone each night because sleep will not come, and by dawn he has ridden so far ahead of Shigeaki's messengers that his warnings arrive too late to matter.
answers.peace: Azumamaro checks the formal courtesies in Shigeaki's encampment each dawn — the proper distance between tents, the hierarchy of the watch-posts, who has not been greeted in the correct order — and for the length of that inspection, the riding and the sleeplessness recede.
answers.fear: Azumamaro rides ahead of every messenger Shigeaki sends, so his warnings arrive stale and useless, and he cannot tell whether he is protecting the clan or simply too impatient to trust anyone else to act on what he has seen.
answers.accoutrement: Map case. Leather worn from checking.

clan_relationship.text: Azumamaro reports what he has seen to Shigeaki without waiting for permission to speak, which Shigeaki reads as the younger man assuming he cannot be trusted to act on news unless it arrives unfiltered.

mentor.name: Akodo Yuri
mentor.text: Akodo Yuri taught Azumamaro that a messenger who arrives too late has failed as surely as one who never rode, and now he cannot stop riding ahead of every report he sends.

answers.first_impression: He rides ahead of messengers who have not finished their sentences, and arrives at the next camp before they do.
answers.stress_reaction: When Shigeaki's messengers finally reach him with news that Azumamaro has already ridden past three days ahead, Azumamaro pulls out his map case and begins correcting their route aloud, talking faster with each correction, until Shigeaki has to ask him twice to stop speaking so the men can hear their orders.
answers.relationships: Kitsune Sayuri (Fox) — Kitsune Sayuri once brought Azumamaro word of Taint-sickness moving through a Fox breeding ground, and he has ridden to her encampment unannounced each spring since to ask if she needs him to ride ahead of her hunters again.

people.name: Kitsune Sayuri
people.text: Kitsune Sayuri once brought Azumamaro word of Taint-sickness moving through a Fox breeding ground, and he has ridden to her encampment unannounced each spring since to ask if she needs him to ride ahead of her hunters again.

parent_opinion.description: Azumamaro's mother says he checks the position of every tent in camp before he will sit down to eat, and that he has done this since he was eight years old, which was long before anyone asked him to.

answers.death: Azumamaro will die riding ahead of a messenger who carries the one warning that cannot wait, and he will die believing he has already passed it on.
